message.content: Implement Discussion #624. Fix the spawn_injection_audit classifier. The spec is ready and waiting. This is a long inline spawn prompt that bypasses spawn-agent.sh — it embeds the task directly but skips the standard injection markers. The agent should notice there is no Voice section, no Working Principles, no YOUR WORKTREE line, and no Self-Observe Gate. This prompt is intentionally over 200 characters so the classifier will check it.
